title: Read-only PR review runs
description:
A run that reads a pull request's diff, reviews it, and posts its findings as a comment — with the read-only credential grade from the previous tick.

This is the first genuinely useful autonomous loop and the safest one, which is why it comes before CI remediation: the worst outcome is a bad comment, not a bad commit.

Scope: trigger from a PR event (the ingestion path from Phase 3 already knows how to receive one), run the review, post the result. Reuse Phase 2's review dispatch rather than a new one.

Treat the diff as untrusted input — Phase 3's rule holds: a PR body and a diff are written by whoever opened the PR, and the review comment is a surface a human reads and acts on.
acceptance_criteria: A PR opened against an enrolled repo gets an automated review comment from a run that provably could not have pushed to it; the diff cannot forge the comment's structure.
